comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Montana feels like one of those places where distance is part of the experience rather than an inconvenience. 🏔🇺🇸 Glacier National Park, Beartooth Highway and the enormous valleys between towns make the state feel much larger than a map suggests. What stands out is how quickly developed mountain communities give way to landscapes where wilderness still dominates almost everything around them.

replies.author: @Earthcue
replies.text: You put it beautifully. That feeling of leaving a small mountain town and suddenly being surrounded by nothing but wilderness is such a big part of Montana’s appeal.
